description: Converted enemies get their health, resistances, XP and damage from Fallout 76's level curves.
x-help:
A curve turns a level into a number: the x axis is the creature's level, the y axis the stat. Enemies, races, weapons, explosions and armors point at curves, so the same enemy hits harder or has more health at a higher level.

Curves are shared: define one under Curves, then point NPCs or weapons at it. 'Baked' numbers are what the conversion wrote into the record; Tales swaps them for the curve value at the right level.

Only NPCs carrying the marker value are affected; ordinary Fallout 4 NPCs are never touched.
